catalog_name: Inventory, fulfilment and manufacturing mathematical contracts
scope: Self-contained quantity, valuation, fulfilment, manufacturing and quality decision contracts. Business arithmetic is independent of implementation language and storage engine.
verification_status: Arithmetic fixtures checked independently against these formulas; business branches reviewed in supplied implementation. Full application transaction suites and simultaneous posting scenarios have not been executed.

calculations.name: Transaction quantity to stock quantity
calculations.evidence_status: Reviewed business decision; independent numerical acceptance available in this repository

operands.name: transaction_quantity
operands.numeric_representation: Decimal unless explicitly described as a count or date

operands.name: stock_units_per_transaction_unit
operands.meaning_and_unit: Stock units represented by one transaction unit
operands.numeric_representation: Decimal unless explicitly described as a count or date

calculations.rounding_and_sequence: Preserve transaction factor; apply target stock quantity field precision and whole-number constraint.
conditions_and_failures: Stock unit conversion must equal one.
Product unit conversion rows must not repeat a unit.
calculations.decision_procedure: Read the factor stored on the transaction row; multiply its commercial quantity by that factor; apply the destination quantity precision and the stock unit whole-number restriction. Never infer the factor from price or parcel size.

calculations.name: Price per stock unit
calculations.evidence_status: Reviewed business decision; independent numerical acceptance available in this repository

operands.numeric_representation: Decimal unless explicitly described as a count or date

operands.name: stock_units_per_transaction_unit
operands.numeric_representation: Decimal unless explicitly described as a count or date

calculations.rounding_and_sequence: Do not infer factor from a price or package dimension; the inspected rate helper treats a missing factor as one.
conditions_and_failures: A selected factor of zero cannot be used as an actual divisor.
calculations.decision_procedure: Divide the price per selected transaction unit by stock units per that unit. Preserve document currency. Quantity times transaction price must equal converted stock quantity times unrounded stock-unit price.

conditions_and_failures: Do not post another stock movement for a non-stock commercial parent.
calculations.decision_procedure: Resolve the selected eligible composition version; multiply each component quantity by the parent stock quantity. Retain the commercial parent row and component reference, including duplicate components belonging to different parents.

calculations.name: Net weight of a packing slip
calculations.evidence_status: Reviewed business decision; independent numerical acceptance available in this repository

operands.name: rows
operands.meaning_and_unit: For each row: quantity in row stock units and net weight per stock unit in a common weight unit
operands.numeric_representation: Decimal unless explicitly described as a count or date

calculations.rounding_and_sequence: Round the total to two decimal places after summing products.
conditions_and_failures: All row weight units must match.
Gross weight defaults to net weight only when its entered value is empty or zero.
calculations.decision_procedure: Require a common row weight unit. Fill absent row weights from product defaults, multiply packed row quantities by unit weights, sum and round the total to two decimal places. Inclusive case count does not multiply row quantity.

calculations.name: Total shipment parcel weight
calculations.evidence_status: Reviewed business decision; independent numerical acceptance available in this repository

operands.name: parcels
operands.meaning_and_unit: Each parcel has weight in kilograms and integer parcel count
operands.numeric_representation: Decimal unless explicitly described as a count or date

calculations.expression: sum(parcel.weight × parcel.count for parcels whose count is positive)
calculations.rounding_and_sequence: Parcel weight field has one decimal place in inspected metadata; no separate total rounding appears in the helper.
conditions_and_failures: Every parcel weight must be positive.
This expression is physical weight, not a carrier dimensional-weight tariff.
calculations.decision_procedure: Require every parcel weight to be positive. Sum weight times count only for positive-count parcel rows. Do not derive volumetric weight or alter commercial stock quantity.

calculations.decision_procedure: Select the approved standard effective on the posting date. Multiply the resulting quantity by that standard, independently of purchase or actual manufacturing cost. Recognise price or manufacturing variance separately.

calculations.decision_procedure: Validate nonzero manual total, subtract allocated charges from required charges, and round the difference at company-currency precision. Absorb the difference into the final row only when its absolute amount is strictly below two smallest currency units.

ordered_layer_procedures.name: First in first out
ordered_layer_procedures.receipt_rule: Merge into last layer when rate matches; otherwise append for positive existing layer. Negative layer clearing retains old rate until receipt creates positive remainder.
ordered_layer_procedures.issue_rule: When explicit outgoing rate is positive or purchase-return mode is active, prefer first exactly matching rate layer; otherwise consume earliest layer. Fall back to earliest layer if no rate match.
ordered_layer_procedures.rounding_rule: Normalise absolute magnitude strictly below 0.0000001 to zero.
state_invariants: The sum of layer quantities equals carried stock quantity at the applicable tolerance.
The sum of layer quantity multiplied by rate equals carried inventory value before company-currency rounding.
An issue consumes only its required quantity, carries any unconsumed part of a layer forward and uses negative remainder handling only when the negative-stock policy permits it.

ordered_layer_procedures.name: Last in first out
ordered_layer_procedures.receipt_rule: Same receipt and negative-layer handling as first in first out.
ordered_layer_procedures.issue_rule: Consume latest layer; explicit outgoing rate does not choose a matching positive layer. Exhausted negative remainder uses supplied outgoing rate or exhausted rate.
ordered_layer_procedures.rounding_rule: Normalise absolute magnitude strictly below 0.0000001 to zero.
